# Movements

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Every patient moving to a bed, by stage, from referral to arrival.

## What is on the screen

1. Open movements. Everyone moving to a bed now, from referral to arrival.
2. Highlight movements. Tier 1 and the other figures highlight those movements in the list below. Nothing is hidden.
3. Your queue. How many are waiting on you. Next in my queue opens the first one.
4. Transport, Find a bed, Corridors. Transport opens the transport jobs, Find a bed the bed finder, and Corridors the routes in use now.
5. Stages. How many are at each stage, from Referred to on the way, with the longest wait in each.
6. All and Resolved today. All shows the open movements and today's resolved ones. Resolved today shows only those closed since midnight.
7. The timeline. What is coming up for each receiving ward. Graph or Table above it swaps it for the people list.
8. Transport right now. Each transport leg on the go, grouped by stage, such as Collected and Accepted.
9. Find a movement. Type a name, UMRN or ED. Sort beside it sets how the list is sorted.
10. Open a movement. Movements are listed by stage. Open one to see its bed, transport and legal form in one place.
11. Share. Print list for a meeting, or Export list as a spreadsheet.

## On a phone

- Filter. Narrow the list to the movements you are looking for.

## Jobs done here

- Pull the bed for a patient. Once a ward accepts, open the movement and press Pull the bed on its Bed step. In Destination and placement, check the receiving ward, choose an observation level if asked, then press Pull the bed. The bed is kept within the pull time limit. A person always chooses the bed; nothing is placed automatically.
- Book transport. Book by phone first. Then open a movement whose next step is Record transport booking, press Record booking on its Transport step and fill in the booking: who is collecting, the CAD number, the time, escort and legal status, then press Record booking. BedChart records it for the transport officer; it does not order the vehicle.
- Book transport. Open the patient from Coming and going, press the Destination row, then Record transport booking. Fill in the booking made by phone and press Record booking. You may record a booking for a journey your ward sent. BedChart records the booking; it does not order a vehicle.
- Cancel transport. On Movements, open a referral your ED sent. Under Transport booked with no bed pulled, choose a reason, then press Cancel the transport job. This control handles orphaned jobs only; ask the coordinator about ordinary bookings. No cancellation is possible after collection.
- Cancel transport. On Coming and going, open the movement. Under Transport booked with no bed pulled, choose a reason, then Cancel the transport job. Only the sending ward recorded as booker may cancel; receiving the patient is not enough. Ask the coordinator about ordinary bookings. No cancellation is possible after collection.
- Cancel transport. Open the movement and press its Destination row. Under Review & corrections, open Cancel transport, choose the reason and press Cancel transport. The bed stays pulled. Do this before you release a pulled bed, so the officer is not sent for a patient whose bed has gone.
- Ask a ward to pull a patient now. Open the movement and press Pull now. The ward is asked to pull the patient, and the button then reads Pull now sent, answer by, with the time. It also shows on the ward's banner. The ward still decides.
- Ask a ward to review its bed numbers from a movement. Open the movement, then Additional workflow controls. Under Movement workflow actions, press Request ward capacity review. The ward is asked to review and confirm its capacity.
- Flag a patient as urgent, or remove the flag. Open the movement, choose why it is urgent and press Flag this patient as urgent. It then leads the queue ahead of every tier. Remove the urgent flag puts it back in order by tier, then wait.
- Withdraw a ward's acceptance. On the movement's page, open Additional workflow controls, then Withdraw the ward's acceptance. Choose a reason and press Withdraw acceptance. The ward is told it no longer stands, a pulled bed is released and the movement goes back to Destination review.
- Correct a stage recorded by mistake. On the movement's page, open Additional workflow controls, then Correct the recorded stage. Choose the stage to go back to and a reason, then press Correct the record. It corrects the record only; nobody moves.

In BedChart, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
